Times are Asia/Seoul. Newest first.

## 2026-11-08 22:37 · claude-macbook · dh-polytone-reconnect-crash

Crash "Distant Horizons gave Polytone a Biome that is not in the current client level registry" (crash-reports 2026-11-08 18:17..22:32, 7x) = 2nd server connection in the same game run. DH 3.3.4 BiomeWrapper.WRAPPER_BY_BIOME / WRAPPER_BY_RESOURCE_LOCATION are static, never cleared; deserialize(string) returns cached wrapper holding the previous connection's Holder<Biome>. Polytone 6.8.6 DistantHorizonsCompat$LodTint checks registry and calls Minecraft.delayCrash. Not caused by the glint-outline port. Fix: local mod ~/dev/dh-reconnect-fix (jar in mods) clears both maps via reflection on ClientPlayConnectionEvents.INIT. No newer DH/Polytone 26.3 builds on Modrinth as of 2026-11-08; no Polytone config toggle.
